purpose: Pin the live embargo, licence, overlap and activation boundary for the two Universidad de León injection-moulding datasets so an early or scheduled public release can be detected without premature retrieval or double counting.

releaseWatch.earlyReleaseCondition: Full open access may be granted earlier once the associated publications are released.
releaseWatch.onEarlyOpen: Fail the watch job with an actionable release-detected result; do not ingest until the activation checklist is completed.
releaseWatch.onDateReachedStillEmbargoed: Fail closed and require a live Zenodo recheck; do not assume a date alone makes files reusable.

records.title: Injection-Molded Polypropylene Parts: Experimental Process Dataset with Part Weights, Energy Consumption and CAD Geometry
records.countingBoundary: The metadata uses batch, part and two-cavity-cycle language that must be reconciled against the delivered CSV before an injection-cycle count is accepted.

records.title: Injection-molded plastic parts defect dataset: raw images, segmentation masks, and quantitative defect metrics under varying process parameters
records.countingBoundary: This record is a companion quality/vision view of the same 1,000-batch campaign as the process record and must not create a second independent injection experiment family.

activationChecklist: Confirm the live Zenodo record reports public/open file access rather than merely reaching the planned embargo date.
Confirm the record still grants CC BY 4.0 to the released files.
Capture the exact released filenames, byte sizes and checksums before parsing.
Profile delivered schemas without committing raw rows or images to the repository.
Reconcile batch, shot, part, cavity and image semantics across both companion records.
Preserve one shared overlap group and prevent companion-record double counting.
Only then update inventory access state, automated-ingestion flags and accepted measured counts.
